restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7, E1.c1 lies in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 so that beta = beta* in every trial, Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), and the counter t is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1; trials with t = 0 are skipped. The search continues only in outer steps that pass the exact filter of proof.md Section 8 for the six listed E1 outcomes S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 (share 279,070,422,111 / 2^48 = 2^-9.9782); of these, the joint solver sees only those kept by the exact s-pattern pre-check, and its guard (G7) drops only words that hold no success, so by Lemmas F, VP and G7 none of these steps loses a counted success. The eight other outcomes of beta* are not counted as successes.

Heuristic part: under H1', H4' and H5', each stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12, with probability at least 0.39 the search finds a trial whose remaining 128 chaining-value bits also agree. It walks 2^90.465 trials: 2^50.465 contexts (proof.md 9.8), each the seven outer words of one fresh draw, times the 2^19 members of the class, times the 2^21 trials of an outer step.

Machine: a classical word RAM with 256-bit words under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) to the unit, 64 registers and constants as immediates; fetching a word from memory is a load. Charges (proof.md 9.8, 11; GPT Sol answer CD): 600 units per context, which draws its fresh word and runs the 39 member-free lines of step CO once; 67 units per batch of seven members in packed 36-bit lanes (37 for the last batch of a context), which computes the 8 member lines on which omega depends and omega and tests every lane against the direct table T2; and 67 units for each lane whose test-(2) mask meets S, which updates the E count in six operations, computes the 17 lines on which only Y9 depends in 16 packed lines and tests against T1. Participant programs executed and counted the batch of 67 and this Q path in its earlier form of 78; the organizer does not run them.

Building T1 and T2, one entry per 32-bit word, costs below 2^39 units once (2^38 bytes). A passing lane is charged 450 units, its rebuild, the 26 words saved around the solver, pre-check, the three words of (G7) and its credit test included. When the pre-check keeps outcomes T, the proved cap C(T) <= 31,456 of the joint solver with the guard (G7) and of the root certificates is subtracted from a prepaid credit of 3,795,525,293,015,086,772,861 units before the solver starts. These are proved upper allowances of a specified layout, not measured counts. Nothing is sorted, every word-indexed read is charged as a load, and the tables do not grow with the trials.

Halts: the run stops with failure as soon as the test-(2) count or the pass count passes its budget, as soon as a C(T) is larger than the credit left, and after RUN_CONTEXTS = 1,553,906,557,396,539 contexts. The time bound charges each budget plus one, RUN_CONTEXTS + 1 contexts, all RUN_BATCHES batches and the whole credit, so it holds for every run (proof.md Sections 9, 11).

This package is our entry 415e792c with the member loop and the direct tables of entry e9b6649e (hecmas), the guard (G7) of our entry 0bc5f130 with the credit at the exact mean with (G7) of entry 77818485 (Th0rgal), and the omega-first batch (GPT Sol, answer CA, its charges audited in answer CD). Randomness: one fresh uniform 256-bit word per context. Since each context visits each member of the class exactly once (Lemma CX), means over outer steps equal those of a uniform outer step; independence, however, holds between contexts only, as the 2^19 outer steps of a context share its words. H1' (ii) is therefore stated per context, which is stronger than a per-step clause. Success 0.39 holds only under H1', H4' and H5'.

The factor 98,937,639,497 in H1' is five sevenths of the model's conditional count of the six listed outcomes on the class, rounded down, and is not measured by the organizer-run experiments, which run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11): no digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk's chaining value. The filter, the pre-check and (G7) lose nothing; the two count shares matter only for the budgets (H4') and the mean of C(T) with (G7) only for the credit (H5'). No full 2-round collision is exhibited.

The submitted program is that of entry 26ebba63, unchanged (the earlier sub-class search, its own constants); it does not run the member loop, the direct tables, the omega-first batch, the pre-check, the guard (G7) or the credit. All of these, with the outcome set, the budgets, the solver layout and the certificate, exist in proof.md only. The participant programs cited in proof.md 9.8 and Section 13 (checks of the member loop and of the omega-first batch up to the pass decision, and the clustering measurement) are not part of the package.

Fixed nonuniform advice, stated in full in proof.md Section 12: the six 32-bit constants of 3.2, eta = 830303cf, beta* = 18b0e098 with the mask 0e09818b and value 02008000 of its cube, the seven tau values and eps = 6e21be55 of the filter's automata and the mask 5f of S, 73 bytes that the search reads, and 20 bytes of the root instance, 93 bytes in all (nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes 7). The success analysis uses only properties of this stated record that proof.md verifies exactly: Fact P (3.2), Lemma Q, Theorem C (iii) and (iv), the table of 10.1 with the program of Section 17, the certificate of the filter for S (Section 8), and the pre-check patterns and solver guards, trees and caps for this class (9.4, 9.7, 11). H1', H4' and H5' are stated for this record and none concerns how it was found; no premise concerns what any selection returns. HPRE-discovery-bound bounds only the cost of the computation that found it (preprocessing_log2).

preprocessing_log2 61.2519, included in time_log2, is the charge for all computation that produced the advice: P = 2^70 machine units = 2^70 / 430 = 2^61.25181 units, a hardware bound over the participant's attested device list and window of 30 days (proof.md Section 12), under the supporting premise HPRE-discovery-bound. The search alone is below 2^64.9323 units. memory_log2_bytes 44 covers, all held at once (sum below 2^44), the two output messages (each below 2^42 bytes), the code and the search with its direct tables (2^38 bytes), and also the discovery computation: the memory of every attested device together is 1,688 GiB, below 2^41 bytes (proof.md Section 12). No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Stated for the instance that the advice record of proof.md Section 12 fixes, and for no other. The run has RUN_CONTEXTS independent contexts, each the seven outer words of one fresh uniform 256-bit word, and every context visits all 2^19 members of the class (proof.md 9.8, Lemma CX). Let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step (t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome in S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0, six outcomes of beta*; Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1), counted over all of Q* whether or not the outer step passes the filter or the pre-check, and N_c its sum over the 2^19 outer steps of a context. (i) For a uniform outer step U (seven uniform outer words, a uniform member), E[N_o(U)] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(5 * 138,512,695,296 / 7) = 98,937,639,497, about 2^-91.474 (just under five sevenths of the conditional model rate p of Lemma S1 for S); by Lemma CX (c), E[N_c] = 2^19 E[N_o(U)], so (i) is the statement of entry 415e792c. (ii) With the context as the unit, as entry e9b6649e declares it: the probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.49676) + 0.001; that is, listed good trials are not clustered, neither among the trials of one outer step nor among the outer steps (members) of one context, beyond what this bound allows. Given (i), rho_c = E[N_c(N_c-1)]/E[N_c] <= 0.0065 is sufficient for (ii) by Lemma S8 applied to the independent contexts. rho_c = rho_w + rho_x, where rho_w is the per-step factorial ratio of entry 415e792c and rho_x >= 0 the part that pairs of different members of one context add, so this clause is stronger than the per-step clause of entry 415e792c. A dependence clause of this kind stated per outer step was ruled unsupported in the reviews of entries 1a92bf64 and afbe2154. This restates the rate-and-dependence premise of entry 26ebba63 for the whole class, S and the walk by contexts; that entry's clause was for the sub-class of 2^17 members with rule A and seven outcomes and does not by itself imply this law (GPT Sol, answer AT 2). It is declared here anew. By Lemma F every listed good trial lies in an outer step that passes the filter, by Lemma VP the pre-check skips none and by Lemma G7 the guard (G7) drops none, so N_o is the same count, pointwise (GPT Sol, answer AW 1).
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 ranging over all 524,288 members of the class of eta (Lemma Q) inside every context, a context being the seven outer words of one fresh 256-bit word of the run (proof.md 9.8, Lemma CX); in every trial E1.c1 is drawn from the cube of beta* = 18b0e098, and t is solved per trial, with t = 0 skipped. The search continues only in outer steps that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for S, the solver sees only those that the pre-check of 9.7 keeps, and it applies the guard (G7); N_o counts all of Q* in every outer step and only the six outcomes of S.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's exact count, in integer arithmetic under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class, of the part of beta* on the class carried by the six outcomes of S (67,633,152 = 1,032 * 2^16 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 of the class; the counting program and the six rows of its output are printed in Section 17), times 2^11 for drawing E1.c1 from the cube (Lemma S1), taken at five sevenths, rounded down. The filter, the pre-check and (G7) change neither the count nor the premise (Lemmas S9 (b), VP and G7). Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness: a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials in 2^25 passing outer steps, with a sub-class control of the same size, in which every measured quantity matches the exact model within 1.5 clustered standard errors, among them the E1 rate on the whole class of the seven outcomes of entry 59f8915e, 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model (13,595 events), and its ratio to the sub-class rate, 0.9895 +- 0.0120 (model 1); the E1 event of S is a sub-event of that measured event (52/53 of it in the model); and a reduced-width (8-bit) end-to-end run of complete messages, with no sub-class and no rule, in which the counter arrangement found 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted. At 32 bits the joint 128-bit event itself, about 2^-91 per trial, is not measured. Member loop (Section 13, one SplitMix64 run made after the design): over 120,000 contexts with all 2^19 members each, 62,914,560,000 outer steps, the events of the filter cluster by context: per-context pass counts have E[n(n-1)]/E[n] = 597.82 against 519.81 for independent members (variance 79.77 times binomial, pair correlation 1.47 * 10^-4), and the counts of lanes with a nonzero test-(2) mask 32,581.2 against 28,529.7. No listed good trial is measured and rho_x is not measured. If listed good trials at different members of a context were independent, rho_x would be about 2^-51.474, so (ii) fails only if a success at one member raises the chance of successes at other members of its context by a factor of the order of 2^44.
heuristics.limitations: The factor 98,937,639,497 is assumed (five sevenths of the model count of the six outcomes of S on the class, rounded down). The premise of entry 26ebba63 was for the sub-class with rule A; it is not inherited, and the whole-class law of N_o for S is declared, not proved. The organizer-run experiments run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11) of the same construction and measure neither the factor nor the counter half-collision, which no digest experiment can show. Part of the transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is proved (Lemmas S1-S5, S8, S9, VP and G7) and part is assumed in (i); the dependence condition (ii) is assumed, with a proved cap of 32 listed good trials in one outer step (Lemmas CV and G7). Part (ii) is stated for contexts: it is stronger than the per-step clause of entry 415e792c, since it adds the cross-member part rho_x, which is assumed and not measured; the measurement by context covers the events of the filter, which do cluster, and not listed good trials. A per-step clause of this kind was ruled unsupported for entries 1a92bf64 and afbe2154. The whole-class graphics-card run measures the E1 side of the seven outcomes together and the filter, not the six of S on their own, not the E3 side nor the joint event. Lemmas F, VP, G7 and S9 (a) use no law of the words; the 8-bit end-to-end run has no filter.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. Two count-budget clauses with one failure allowance for their union: with probability at least 0.9995 over the coins both hold, and then no budget halts the run. (a) Pass budget: no more than PASS_BUDGET = 858,218,304,486,124,637 outer steps pass the filter for S, whose nominal share is pi = 279,070,422,111 / 2^48 = 2^-9.9782. (b) Test-(2) budget: no more than E_BUDGET = 47,103,299,361,697,989,262 lanes run the Q path because their test-(2) mask meets S, with nominal share 233,715,456 / 2^32 = 2^-4.1998. Each budget is ceil(17/16 * RUN_STEPS * share), with RUN_STEPS = 814,694,561,164,316,639,232 = 2^19 * RUN_CONTEXTS. Reaching a budget halts with failure; the time bound charges each budget plus one. Both counts add up independent per-context counts, each between 0 and 2^19 (Lemma CX). Provided that, for a uniform outer step, each indicator has probability at most 1.06 times its nominal share, Bernstein's inequality over the contexts bounds each overflow by exp(-3 RUN_STEPS p / (2^20 * 509,200)), that is below exp(-2.4 * 10^8) for (b) and exp(-4.5 * 10^6) for (a), far below 0.0005 together. The number of outer steps that reach the solver has no budget and no clause here: the solver is paid from the credit of H5prime-weighted-solver-work (GPT Sol, answer AW 5).
heuristics.scope: The counts N_E and N_2 of proof.md 10.3, taken over all RUN_STEPS outer steps, every member of every context (9.1, 9.8): per context, each count lies between 0 and 2^19, the contexts are independent, and the mean per context is 2^19 times the indicator's probability for a uniform outer step (Lemma CX (c)); the two indicators of one outer step may depend on each other in any way.
heuristics.extrapolation: The nominal shares are exact for uniform independent (Y9, omega) (GPT Sol, answers AC, AN and AW 3; the certificate of Section 8). Measured (Section 13, untrusted by the harness, whole class): on 60,000,000 real outer steps from Python's generator the two counts are 1.0004 +- 0.0005 (test (2)) and 0.9980 +- 0.0041 (pass) of their nominal values; on another 30,000,000 the pass count is 0.9981 +- 0.0058 of its nominal value. With the member loop, one SplitMix64 run of 120,000 contexts with all 2^19 members each: pass share 0.99847 and test-(2) share 0.99868 of nominal, z = -1.36 and -1.21 against the standard errors of the per-context counts. On 2^35 outer steps of the sub-class, with the seven-outcome filter, the pass share was 1.00012 +- 0.00016 of its exact value.
heuristics.limitations: The bound of 1.06 times the nominal share on each indicator's probability is not proved: Y9 and omega are not proved independent and uniform. The measurements are runs of generators made after the design, not a locked validation. Over contexts the tails are weaker than over independent outer steps and still far below 0.0005 (exp(-4.5 * 10^6) for the pass count). The time bound, the filter and the pre-check do not depend on these shares.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. This is the premise H4-AS-v-S(eps) of GPT Sol's answer AW 5, E_phys[V_S(U)] <= (1+eps) * cbar_S, taken at eps = 0.06 for the caps with the guard (G7) of answer AX 1; the mean with (G7) is the one derived in entry 77818485. For an outer step U of the run, before any halt, let V(U) = C(T(U)), where T = X AND VMASK[nu] is the set of outcomes that the pre-check of proof.md 9.7 keeps and C is the proved (G7) cap of steps 2 and 3 on those outcomes (4,096 + 2,304 F + 1,280 A + 20 N_f + 48 N_r + 4 N_s + 368 Lf over the rows of T with their trees with (G7), Section 11; at most 31,456), with V(U) = 0 when T is empty or the step does not pass the filter. Premise: for a uniform outer step, and hence for the mean over the outer steps of one context (Lemma CX (c)), the mean E[V(U)] is at most 1.06 * cbar, where cbar = 582,173,006,981,436 / 2^47 = 4.136588... is the exact mean of V in the counting model. This is a single weighted moment over all outer steps, the zeros counted; it is not a mean of executed work, because V bounds the work of steps 2 and 3 in every outer step. Use: the run debits C(T) before steps 2 and 3 from a credit that starts at CREDIT = ceil(17/16 * RUN_STEPS * 1.06 * cbar) = 3,795,525,293,015,086,772,861, and it halts with failure when C(T) exceeds what is left; the per-context sums of V are independent and lie between 0 and 2^19 * 31,456, and the Bernstein inequality over contexts puts the probability that the credit is exhausted below exp(-4.1 * 10^8). The time bound charges the whole credit whether or not the premise holds; success 0.39 holds under H1', H4' and this premise (proof.md 10.3, 10.4).
heuristics.scope: V(U) for every one of the RUN_STEPS outer steps of proof.md 9.1, that is, for every member of every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts (9.8), as a function of the context's outer words and the member, with S = 0x5f, the masks X of the filter of Section 8, nu by formula (V) of 9.7 and the caps with (G7) of Section 11; the mean is over all outer steps, passing or not.
heuristics.extrapolation: cbar is exact in the counting model M_v of proof.md 10.3 (uniform independent (Y9, omega) and an independent uniform three-bit nu): CBAR = 582,173,006,981,436 is an eighth of the sum of n_X C(X) over the ten masks X of S that occur, 4,657,384,055,851,488, recounted by the participant in integers from the certificate of Section 8 and the trees with (G7); without (G7) the same sum gives 611,713,706,062,329. Measured, untrusted by the harness: entry 77818485 reports 2^25 real outer steps with V with (G7), mean 4.058286 against 4.136588, ratio 0.98107 +- 0.01126, one-sided empirical Bernstein upper bound 1.03053 (delta 0.00135, range 31,456), below 1.06; it was not rerun here. The participant's preregistered sample (PREREG.txt SHA-256 c862bfb1082e5236b0d9d81d6daef38e5f1135b27b25ad5c0093a1bf76455872) of 2^28 = 268,435,456 real outer steps measured V without (G7): ratio 0.99456 +- 0.00405 to 4.346487, one-sided upper bounds 1.01059 (empirical Bernstein) and 1.01513 (bounded KL). Since V with (G7) is at most 723/715 times V without it in every outer step, that sample bounds the mean with (G7) by 1.0786 times cbar.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the sampler's nu is a function of the outer step and is not proved uniform or independent of the masks, so cbar is not a property of the sampler. Support at eps = 0.06 rests on the model and on the other participant's 2^25-step sample; the participant's own preregistered sample supports only eps = 0.0786, through the pointwise ratio 723/715. Both samples come from pseudorandom generators run outside the organizer's harness, on the counter instance that no organizer experiment runs, and neither tests H1' or H4'. If the premise fails, the credit can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound. This premise takes the place of the third count budget of our entry 0bc5f130.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; it enters only the preprocessing charge P of time_log2 and preprocessing_log2, not the success probability (proof.md 10.4) and not the search part of the time. All computation that produced the stated advice of proof.md Section 12 (the solver runs, the exact counts, the choice of S and the exact computations that derive the numbers of 9.1 from the advice) is at most 2^70 charged word operations of the cost model, under the participant's attested device list and window of 30 days. It is charged as P = 2^70 machine units = 2^70 / 430 = 2,745,561,908,645,142,566.10... target-compression units, 2^61.25181 (preprocessing_log2 61.2519, rounded up at the fourth decimal: 2^700000 < 430^10000 * 2^612519 and 2^700000 >= 430^10000 * 2^612518). With it the exact total of proof.md Section 11 is N = 15,136,396,605,699,096,622,327 + 430 * 2^38 + 2^70 = 16,316,988,344,614,007,911,671 machine units and T = N / 430, log2 T = 65.04060003903857...; in integers N^10000 < 430^10000 * 2^650407 and N^10000 >= 430^10000 * 2^650406, so time_log2 = 65.0407. P is 2^-3.6804 times the search part and adds 0.1084 to log2 T.
heuristics.scope: Every machine used by any of the project's models, as attested by the participant: one RTX 3090 (local), four RTX 3070 (server), 24 local CPU cores, an allowance of 64 server CPU cores, and at most four cloud and model sandboxes of 64 cores each running at all times, over a window of 30 days (2,592,000 s) from the start of the project on 2026-10-05. Computation means operations executed on these machines by any program of the project (the SAT solver, the counting programs, generators and scripts). The inference of the AI models that wrote formulas and code is not a search over candidates and is not counted. The participant's records of the logged search (116 solver runs, each within 9,010.5 s on one core, and 65 recounts, each within 320 s; at most 1,066,018 core-seconds) are context, not the basis of the bound.
heuristics.extrapolation: From peak hardware rates to a bound on charged operations (proof.md Section 12, the list). Every charged word operation (an addition, subtraction, XOR, rotation, AND, comparison or load of a 32-bit word) is taken to need at least one hardware 32-bit lane-instruction, so a device performs at most lanes x clock x operations per lane per cycle charged operations a second, at peak boost clock with every lane busy in every cycle and fused operations counted as two: one RTX 3090, 10,496 x 2.1 GHz x 2 = 4.408e13; four RTX 3070, 5,888 x 2.0 GHz x 2 each = 9.421e13; 24 local cores, 64 lanes (AVX-512 x 4 ports) x 5.5 GHz x 2 each = 1.690e13; 64 server cores at the same rate = 4.506e13; four sandboxes as 64 cores each = 1.802e14; in all 380,467,200,000,000 = 2^48.43 a second. Over 2,592,000 s that is 986,170,982,400,000,000,000 = 2^69.740 operations, below 2^70 by a factor of 1.197, in exact integers. At the same rate per core, 7.04e11 a second, the logged runs come to below 2^59.381 operations, 2^-10.6 of P.
heuristics.limitations: The conversion from hardware 32-bit lane-instructions to charged word operations of the cost model is taken as one-to-one: every charged operation of the programs that ran is taken to need at least one lane-instruction. This is not certified. The device list and the window are the participant's attestation, which no organizer run checks, and the generator, the solver log and the counter are not in the package. The inference of the AI models is not counted. Sensitivity: were the bound 2^72 charged word operations, P would be 2^72 / 430 = 2^63.25181 units (preprocessing_log2 63.2519), N = 19,858,763,206,766,241,821,943 machine units, log2 T = 65.32400101331506... and time_log2 = 65.3241 (in integers N^10000 < 430^10000 * 2^653241 and N^10000 >= 430^10000 * 2^653240), against 65.0407 at 2^70. The success probability 0.39 does not depend on this heuristic.
